candidates.purpose: SEC EDGAR processor with RSS live filing monitoring, daily/full-index workflows, typed APIs, logging and structured extraction
candidates.latencySuitability: MEDIUM-HIGH for filing-event detection via SEC RSS; not a sub-second market-data component
candidates.maintenance: Latest inspected commit 2026-04-23; active in 2026 but not as fresh as edgartools
candidates.documentationAndTests: README exposes workflow documentation, Tests and Coverage badges, typed Python 3.10+ APIs, RSS/daily/full-index workflows
candidates.securityNotes: No market-data credential required for SEC public data. Production use must respect SEC identity/rate policy and isolate parser failures. Optional local storage can be large.
candidates.lookAheadRisk: LOW if accepted-at/accession timestamps are preserved and RSS event time is used. Daily/full-index feeds must never be backfilled into an earlier point-in-time signal.
borrowPatterns: separate live RSS from final daily/full-index reconciliation
event timestamp plus later completeness reconciliation
candidates.reasonNotIntegrated: edgartools remains stronger primary challenger for parsing breadth/freshness; this repository adds useful live-vs-final workflow separation patterns rather than a proven production improvement by itself

promotionRule: No dependency is promoted directly. Reproduce the RSS/live-vs-final reconciliation pattern in a sandbox challenger and benchmark catalyst-time coverage, duplicate rate, parsing failures and attribution error before promotion.
